<!-- Release: v0.10.1 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Align the floating mini-player, customizable tab bar, and Search/More bar with filled transport icons
- Choose full-background artwork or a floating cover over an artwork-colored matte gradient
- Blend lyrics into the player, ease controls downward, and keep the queue shelf separate
- Keep search from reopening the keyboard behind the expanded player

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/32 - Floating navigation, artwork layouts, and shared lyrics presentation

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.10.1-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
